meta.name: design-master
meta.description: Design a master class design system. Use when the user wants to design a master class design system.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建一套高质量的设计系统，统一产品视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品制定统一的设计规范和组件库。
copy.tagline_en: Create a high-quality design system to unify product visual style
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish consistent design standards and component library for your product.

howto.what: Claude 会成为一个设计系统架构师和视觉设计师，输出遵循严格设计原则（如色彩60-30-10法则、8px网格、可访问性对比度等）的完整设计系统，包含色彩、排版、间距等规范。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计一个主类设计系统时触发。

say.text: 请为我的个人理财应用设计一套设计系统。
say.note: Claude将输出色彩、字体、间距等规范。

say.text: 帮我创建一个针对大学生的食谱网站设计系统。
为一个实时监控仪表盘设计色彩和排版。
say.note: 优先考虑密度和扫描性。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a design system architect and visual designer, producing a complete design system with strict principles (60-30-10 color rule, 8px grid, accessibility contrast, etc.), including color, typography, spacing specifications.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests to design a master class design system.

say_en.text: Design a design system for my personal finance app.
say_en.note: Claude will output color, typography, spacing specs.

say_en.text: Create a design system for a recipe site for college students.
I need a design system for a real-time monitoring dashboard.
